run_train_mode: run the rllib driver in train mode with a YAML spec file to start a PPO or DDPPO training run
run_load_mode: run the rllib driver in load mode to restore a trained PPO/DDPPO checkpoint and render the environment
run_gen_expert_demo_mode: run the rllib driver in gen_expert_demo mode to generate state-action pairs from a trained expert policy
run_arg_parser: run the arg_parser function to build an argparse parser with mode, spec, checkpoint, and resource arguments
run_adjust_config: run the adjust_config function to compute rollout_fragment_length and set train_batch_size for PPO or DDPPO algorithms
